registration_statement: Committed alone, after the abep-cli implementation was developed against v1 and before any scoring run of v1 or v2. Never edited after commit: a changed command, case, expectation, exit code or decision rule is acceptance_v3, and no case is removed or weakened after a failure.

supersedes.status: SUPERSEDED_BEFORE_SCORING (never scored; immutable; no v1 report exists)
supersedes.reason: v1's PROV check is internally inconsistent: it requires every record that is not a provenance refusal to carry the five expected governing hashes 'because the tamper operations touch none of these files', but its own case REF-02 rewrites config/MANIFEST.json (manifest_rehash). A truthful REF-02 record carries the sha256 of the rewritten manifest, so v1 would score the CLI as failing for reporting the true hash. Found during development by inspecting the case list, not in a scoring run.
changes_in_v2: checks.per_run PROV: governing_hashes equal the sha256 of the five governing files in the evaluated tree; on the REPOSITORY tree those are the registered expected values (precondition), and so on every CLONE case except REF-02, which carries the sha256 of its rewritten manifest
outputs.result_record.field_rules.components: an empty list on a REFUSED_PROVENANCE record (no component is verified before S-5)
commands[intake surface-v1].payload lists m_mean_build_kg (the build-state mixture mass the surface is evaluated with)
checks.static STATIC-DEP names the command (cargo metadata --format-version 1 --locked --offline)

every reference to ACCEPT-NI-ABEP-CLI-V1 (the contract_id the binary writes, the run-record contract_id, the PROV expectation) becomes ACCEPT-NI-ABEP-CLI-V2; the report is acceptance_report_v2.json / .md
supersedes.unchanged: every command, option, exit code, status source, admission-registry entry, command case, refusal case, run set, expected status / exit / reason code, payload check, determinism check and decision rule of v1

governing_records.sections: sec. 9 (Rust-era test rule), sec. 11 (no production Python dependency), sec. 14 (speed never weakens provenance, determinism, fail-closed semantics), sec. 15 (the active chain)
sec. 5 (bus_power_boundary_a9_v2; the 1.5 kW limit is assessment only)

work_packages SC-WP-13 (admission_criteria: double-run byte identity of every subcommand output and --threads 1 vs default; every output carries implementation = rust, rust_commit, contract_id and the four governing hashes; status vocabulary preserved; exit codes registered; gate: a subcommand reaching a non-admitted component is NOT_EVALUATED, never a silent Python fallback); method_vocabulary NEW_INFRASTRUCTURE_ACCEPTANCE; fail_closed_status_vocabulary
cargo_workspace_proposal (crate abep-cli; dependency_rule types <- provenance <- config/data <- physics <- design/uq <- assess <- evidence <- cli)
§ 2 determinism job (bitwise double run, --threads 1 vs default); § 4 abep hall pin-check; § 5 deterministic output over CLI end-to-end runs
pattern of a NEW_INFRASTRUCTURE_ACCEPTANCE record (cases, decision rules, single acceptance run, report)

scope.what: the deterministic `abep` binary (crate crates/abep-cli): a thin orchestration over the admitted Rust crates. It adds no physics, no requirement threshold and no PASS / FAIL; every result value and status comes from the crate that owns it.
scope.command_set_rule: v1 registers only the commands the admitted crates support today (below). The other SC-WP-13 element commands (sweep, run --states 196 over the full chain, robust, assess, golden check, build <id> --check, config build, hall smoke / schema-check, parity, ci, perf) are not in v1: their components are not admitted (design synthesis, UQ, assessment, the active golden of SC-WP-15, the zero-Python CI of SC-WP-16) or they need the pinned Julia (hall smoke, a registered platform test). Each enters through a later acceptance version when its component is admitted.

not_in_v1_and_why.thermal: NP-THERMAL-CATHODELESS is VERIFIED, not ADMITTED (ledger new_items); no command in v1
not_in_v1_and_why.chemistry: abep-chem has no registered CLI input vocabulary (rate files are consumed through abep-icp); no command in v1
not_in_v1_and_why.julia_check_pin: `abep hall pin-check` v1 performs the file-level pin check of the admitted abep-julia-bridge (PINNED.toml / Manifest.toml / Project.toml consistency and the hall_physics_boundary pin); the Julia-side check_pin() needs the pinned Julia and stays the registered platform test of C-JULIA-BRIDGE-LAUNCH. The record says so (julia_check_pin = NOT_EXECUTED_PLATFORM_TEST).

scope.no_python: the binary never runs python / python3 / pip; its only subprocess is `git` (abep_provenance::run_record::RunRecord::capture, abep_provenance::git); no dependency on pyo3 / maturin

implementation.dependencies: abep-types, abep-provenance, abep-config, abep-data, abep-atmos, abep-intake, abep-mission, abep-subsystems, abep-hall, abep-julia-bridge, abep-icp, serde, serde_json (workspace dependencies only); abep-cli sits at the top of the dependency rule and no crate depends on it
implementation.acceptance_runner: crates/abep-cli/examples/cli_acceptance.rs (runs the cases below against a built `abep` binary and writes the report); the same cases run in cargo test as development regression (not the acceptance report)

invocation.repo: --repo DIR must itself hold Cargo.toml and config/MANIFEST.json (no upward search); without --repo, the repository root is found upward from the working directory (abep_provenance::find_repo_root)
invocation.out: --out DIR is required; the directory is created when absent; it must not lie inside the repository root (REFUSED_OUTPUT_LOCATION; compared after canonicalising the nearest existing ancestor, before anything is created): run outputs never overwrite repository content
invocation.threads: --threads N, an integer >= 1; default std::thread::available_parallelism(). An execution parameter, never an input: it is recorded in the sidecar only
invocation.execution_parameters_not_inputs: --repo, --out and --threads never appear in the result record
invocation.numbers: numeric options are parsed as f64 from their decimal text; a non-finite value or unparsable text is a usage error
invocation.unknown: an unknown group, command or option, a missing required option, a repeated option or a stray argument is a usage error

pipeline.failure: USAGE_ERROR (exit 2): message on stderr, no file written

pipeline.step: resolve --out; refuse a location inside the repository root (the root given by --repo or discovered; compared after canonicalisation)
pipeline.failure: REFUSED_OUTPUT_LOCATION (exit 5): message on stderr, no file written
REFUSED_PROVENANCE code REPOSITORY_NOT_FOUND (exit 4): result record written with status MODEL_ERROR, no sidecar

pipeline.step: verify config/MANIFEST.json and every file it pins (abep_provenance::ConfigManifest::load + verify_all: sha256 and bytes)
pipeline.failure: REFUSED_PROVENANCE code CONFIG_MANIFEST_UNVERIFIED (exit 4): result record written with status MODEL_ERROR, no sidecar

pipeline.step: capture the run record (abep_provenance::run_record::RunRecord::capture with contract_id ACCEPT-NI-ABEP-CLI-V2): git commit and dirty state, rustc, Cargo.lock sha256, the four governing hashes verified while captured, the HallThruster.jl pin, thread settings
pipeline.failure: REFUSED_PROVENANCE code RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE (exit 4): result record written with status MODEL_ERROR, no sidecar

pipeline.step: check the command inputs against their registered vocabularies (design-state ids of the frozen design-state set v2; the ICP flight supply modes)
pipeline.failure: REFUSED_UNREGISTERED_INPUT (exit 3): result record with status NOT_EVALUATED and the sidecar

pipeline.step: verify the admission evidence of every component the command uses (registry below): the evidence file exists, has the registered sha256 and its verdict fields are the registered admitted values
pipeline.failure: a component whose evidence does not verify is ADMISSION_EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIED: the command is not executed, status NOT_EVALUATED (exit 10), reason code COMPONENT_ADMISSION_UNVERIFIED, payload null. A component registered NOT_ADMITTED is executed only where the command registers it (icp status) and its result is never EVALUATED (below).

pipeline.step: execute the command through the crate API and summarise its status by the command's registered status sources
pipeline.failure: a crate error is reported verbatim (reason code CRATE_ERROR, message = the crate's error text) with the crate's fail-closed status; payload null

pipeline.step: write the result record, then the sidecar (which binds the result by sha256); each file written to a temporary name in --out and renamed

field_rules.arguments: the command options in registered order, numbers as parsed f64, strings verbatim
field_rules.rust_commit: RunRecord.git_commit (40 hex); null only on a REFUSED_PROVENANCE record
field_rules.governing_hashes: {config_manifest, architecture, model_set, design_state_set} exactly as RunRecord captured and verified them (path + sha256; design_state_set with its reference record, frozen file path, sha256 and n_states); null only on a REFUSED_PROVENANCE record
field_rules.components: per component used: component, contract_id, admission_evidence {path, sha256}, admission ADMITTED | NOT_ADMITTED | ADMISSION_EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIED; an empty list on a REFUSED_PROVENANCE record
field_rules.status: EVALUATED | NOT_EVALUATED | INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE | OUT_OF_DOMAIN | MODEL_ERROR (abep_types::EvalStatus vocabulary; nothing else)
field_rules.reason: null when status is EVALUATED; else {code, message}
field_rules.payload_format: serde_json | python_json: the payload is the owning crate's own serialization (serde_json for Serialize types, abep_types::pyjson / abep_hall::py dumps for the Python-shaped values, which write NaN / Infinity as Python does)
field_rules.payload: the command payload, or null on a refusal / crate error

result_record.layout: one top-level key per line, each value in compact JSON, the payload spliced verbatim; the file ends with a newline. The envelope adds no time stamp, host name, absolute path or thread count; crate texts (payload, reason.message) are verbatim

sidecar.run_record: abep_provenance::run_record::RunRecord (schema abep_run_record_v1) as captured in S-5
sidecar.rule: every command that passes S-5 writes the sidecar; a REFUSED_PROVENANCE record has no sidecar because no run record can be captured truthfully, and USAGE_ERROR / REFUSED_OUTPUT_LOCATION / OUTPUT_WRITE_ERROR write nothing

outputs.stdout: one line: '<status> <command> -> <result file name>'; never data

status_and_exit_codes.decision: fail-closed statuses map to distinct non-zero exit codes AND are written into the result record; no fail-closed result exits 0

table.record: status MODEL_ERROR, reason.code REPOSITORY_NOT_FOUND | CONFIG_MANIFEST_UNVERIFIED | RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, no sidecar

status_and_exit_codes.aggregation: where a command has several status sources, its status is the most severe: MODEL_ERROR > OUT_OF_DOMAIN > INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE > NOT_EVALUATED > EVALUATED (the input-registration ranking of NP-ICP-NEUTRALIZER, INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE above NOT_EVALUATED). Every source status also stays in the payload verbatim; the summary never relabels it.
status_and_exit_codes.non_admitted_component: a command over a component registered NOT_ADMITTED reports the crate's own status when it is fail-closed; a crate result that is not fail-closed (e.g. CONVERGED) becomes NOT_EVALUATED with reason COMPONENT_NOT_ADMITTED. It is never EVALUATED.

admission_registry.rule: compiled into the binary and verified at run time (S-7); the evidence files are immutable committed reports

entries.note: ledger status RUST_IMPL (IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED / NOT_ADMITTED / NOT_VALIDATED); the file is recorded as its current evidence, not as admission evidence

commands.crate_calls: abep_config::builder::Builder::check (byte-identical reproduction of config/** and MANIFEST.json); abep_provenance::ConfigManifest::verify_all; abep_config::loaders::physics_configuration; abep_config::architecture::ArchitectureDefinition::load
commands.status_sources: EVALUATED iff the build check exit is 0 and every load succeeds; a stale build or a loader refusal is MODEL_ERROR (ConfigError.status)

commands.crate_calls: abep_provenance::verifier::run_checks over CheckName::ALL (prereg_lock, audit_manifest, hallthruster_pin, h2_6_live_sources)
commands.status_sources: each CheckReport.status (EVALUATED without findings, MODEL_ERROR with findings)

commands.crate_calls: abep_atmos::execution::{Environment::load, run} for --threads 1; for N > 1 the required states (abep_atmos::design_state_set::required_states) are split into N contiguous chunks executed by abep_atmos::execution::execute_states on scoped threads and concatenated in file order with the global index restored; the DesignStateRun header is assembled from the same Environment fields `run` uses
commands.thread_rule: the payload bytes are identical for every N (checked against the crate's own run_design_state_set serialization, case DET-ENV-CRATE)

commands.registered_inputs: --state must be a state id of the frozen design-state set v2 (UNREGISTERED_INPUT otherwise); --scattering is passed to the crate verbatim (an unknown kernel is the crate's OUT_OF_DOMAIN UNKNOWN_SCATTERING)
commands.crate_calls: free-stream mass fractions {O: fO, N2: fN2, O2: fO2} of the state (abep_atmos DesignState::atm); m_mean_build_kg = abep_atmos::msis21::atmosphere(frozen v1, 200 km, 'mean').m_mean (the reference frozen_surface_build_atmosphere); abep_intake::surface::FrozenIntakeSurfaces::load + IntakeSurface::eval; abep_intake::surface::surface_v2_gate
commands.payload: {state_id, mass_fractions, m_mean_build_kg, surface_v1: {scattering, eta_c, c_d, k_back, mass_kg, cr_passive, recombination, species}, surface_v2_gate}
commands.status_sources: the v1 evaluation: EVALUATED on success, the crate error's status on refusal (OUT_OF_DOMAIN with the crate's message key). The v2 gate (NOT_EVALUATED, BLOCKED_PENDING_AOCS_POINTING_ENVELOPE) is reported verbatim, not a source: v1 is the frozen reference surface the admitted contract covers.

commands.payload: the StatewiseTMinusD record field by field (design_point, credible_set, n_states, n_t_minus_d_evaluated, states[{state_id, thrust, drag_intake, drag_body, t_minus_d_status, objective}])
commands.status_sources: the per-state t_minus_d_status values (the record's headline); the intake-drag term status (INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE, PARAMETRIC_SENSITIVITY_ONLY) and the body / thrust terms stay in the payload verbatim
commands.registered_inputs: a design point absent from the F1 drag table is the crate's OUT_OF_DOMAIN

commands.payload: {record: {path, reproduced, stale}, rollups, mass_status, mass_gates, al07_value_status}
commands.status_sources: the mass_gates statuses; a record that does not reproduce byte for byte (stale) is MODEL_ERROR

commands.payload: the official flight ledger value (bus_power_boundary_a9_v2; no RFP limit)

commands.status_sources: HallGate.status (NOT_EVALUATED, 'credible Hall transport set EMPTY', while no member is admitted)
verify_pin: EVALUATED when Ok, its error status (MODEL_ERROR) otherwise

commands.registered_inputs: --supply-mode is one of the two flight supply modes (CLAUDE.md: AIR_PRIMARY, XE_CONTINGENCY); anything else is UNREGISTERED_INPUT
commands.crate_calls: abep_icp::IcpModel::load; IcpModel::evaluate(testkit::registered_today_case(mode, ChemistryRegistration::NotRegistered {gas: 'AIR' | 'XE'})): the case holding only what the repository registers today

expected_on_the_acceptance_tree.rule: these are the values at the base commit; a governed configuration change before the acceptance run voids the run (INPUT_MISMATCH, not a verdict) and needs acceptance_v3

trees.REPOSITORY: the repository working tree itself, read only
trees.CLONE: a fresh `git clone --shared --no-checkout` of the repository in a temporary directory, checked out (detached) at the repository HEAD, then the tamper operations applied in order; one clone per case or restored (git checkout -- . ; git clean -fdq) between cases

operations.append_text: append the UTF-8 text to path
operations.manifest_rehash: set config/MANIFEST.json files.<rel>.sha256 and .bytes to the sha256 and size of the (tampered) config/<rel> and re-serialise the manifest

acceptance_cases.out: a fresh temporary directory outside the repository per run, unless the case says otherwise

run_set.R3: no --threads option (default = available_parallelism) with OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 in the environment

payload_checks: 4 checks, each status EVALUATED with no finding
surface_v1 present with finite eta_c and c_d
no key of the ledger payload starts with p_bus_max or contains limit (case-insensitive): the 1.5 kW limit is assessment only
the payload contains the reason code NP_ICP_CHEM_AIR_NOT_ADMITTED
the payload contains the reason code CHG-04_NO_XE_RATE_SET

acceptance_cases.command_case_rule: each command case runs R1..R4 on REPOSITORY

refusal_cases.title: tampered config hash: a manifest-pinned config file changed (one space appended)
tampered config hash: the same file changed again and the manifest re-hashed to match; preflight passes, the byte-identical config build check refuses
missing frozen data file (orbit-resolved NRLMSIS 2.1 dataset)
missing frozen data file (the design-state set the run record verifies)
missing frozen data file (intake surface v1 table)
unregistered input: a design-state id that is not in the frozen set
unregistered input: an ICP supply mode outside the two flight modes
registered input outside the model domain: intake L/d beyond the frozen surface bounds (crate refusal verbatim)
design point outside the F1 drag table (crate refusal verbatim)
tampered admission evidence: a component's parity report changed (one LF appended); the command is not executed
usage: an unregistered command (a legacy entry point is not ported)

acceptance_cases.refusal_case_rule: each refusal case runs once with --threads 1 (REF-11 with --repo set to an empty temporary directory)

per_run: EXIT: the process exit code equals the expected exit, and equals the registered code of the record's status (or refusal)
STATUS: result.status equals the expected status and is in the EvalStatus vocabulary; reason.code equals the expected code; reason is null iff status is EVALUATED
PAYLOAD: the case's payload_checks hold; payload is null where expected
FILES: files written exactly as the sidecar rule says (result + sidecar, result only, or nothing)

PROV: on every result record that is not REFUSED_PROVENANCE: implementation == 'rust', rust_commit == the HEAD of the evaluated tree (40 hex), contract_id == 'ACCEPT-NI-ABEP-CLI-V2', governing_hashes equal the sha256 of the five governing files (config/MANIFEST.json, the architecture, the model set, the design-state set reference and the frozen design-state file) in the evaluated tree; on REPOSITORY these are the five expected values above, and so on every CLONE case except REF-02, whose manifest_rehash rewrites config/MANIFEST.json, components list the command's registered components with the registered contract ids; the sidecar's result_sha256 equals the sha256 of the result file and its run_record has schema abep_run_record_v1, implementation rust, the same git commit and governing hashes
NO_VERDICT: no string value anywhere in a result record (envelope or payload, parsed as Python JSON) equals PASS or FAIL; quoted decision texts are not values
determinism: DET-RUN: for every command case, R1 and R2 result files are byte-identical and their sidecars are byte-identical
DET-THREADS: for every command case, R1, R3 and R4 result files are byte-identical; the sidecars differ only in threads_requested, threads_used and run_record.threads
DET-ENV-CRATE: the payload of CMD-03 under R1 and R4 equals, byte for byte, serde_json::to_string of abep_atmos::execution::run_design_state_set(repository) computed by the runner in process
static: STATIC-DEP: cargo metadata --format-version 1 --locked --offline: abep-cli depends on no pyo3 / maturin package and no workspace crate depends on abep-cli
STATIC-NOPY: no crates/abep-cli source file contains Command::new("python

decision_rules.per_case: every run of the case meets every per_run check
decision_rules.verdict: ACCEPTED iff every case meets per_case, every determinism check holds and every static check holds; otherwise NOT_ACCEPTED
decision_rules.input_mismatch: a governing hash of the repository different from expected_on_the_acceptance_tree voids the run (NOT_RUN_INPUT_MISMATCH), not a verdict
decision_rules.clean_tree: the acceptance run is executed on a clean committed tree (git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no empty); otherwise it refuses (NOT_RUN_INPUT_MISMATCH)
decision_rules.once: executed once for v2 at a recorded commit; the report is committed whatever the verdict; after NOT_ACCEPTED only a code fix plus acceptance_v3 may follow (no case is removed or weakened)
decision_rules.development: cargo test executes the cases as development regression on every run; those runs are not the acceptance report

report_records: rustc version and build profile of the `abep` binary, its sha256
sha256 of every crates/abep-cli source file
per-case, per-run exit code, status, reason code, check results and result / sidecar sha256

admission: on ACCEPTED, NI-ABEP-CLI is requested ACCEPTED (lifecycle PREREG_ACCEPTANCE -> RUST_IMPL -> ACCEPTED -> ADMITTED) in docs/rust_migration/migration_state_v1.json by the ledger owner; ADMITTED additionally needs the CI job that runs the determinism checks (CI_PLAN § 5) and the docs/HISTORY.md entry
what_this_is_not: not physics and not a gate verdict: the CLI never relabels a crate status; NOT_EVALUATED / INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE stay what they are
not admission of any component it calls: NP-ICP-NEUTRALIZER stays NOT_ADMITTED; Hall thrust stays NOT_EVALUATED (credible set EMPTY)
not the full SC-WP-13 command set: later commands enter through acceptance versions as their components are admitted
